analysis_frame.stage_definition: First exclude the selected 5-coordinate instance of each repeated group. Insert one unknown slot before source 118. Both five-slot boundaries are then measured in this 262-slot intermediate stage before either five-slot gap is inserted.
analysis_frame.primary_source_boundary_description: A five-slot gap before source 15; one slot before source 118 in GDDA; a five-slot gap before source 119 at the end of that printed row.

record.readable_german: An OHL. Verpflegung noch 14 Tage U10 Tage. Verpfleg. Zuege nach Arad. Arad bei ungar. Regierung erwirken. STAEKE ?0000 Mann, 30000 Tiere. AOK11. RM. 1C. 18?GLH.
record.meaning: A conditional provisions report addressed to OHL contains the literal duration labels 14 and 10, a proposal concerning provisions trains to Arad and the Hungarian government, and a field apparently concerning manpower and animals. The transmitted repetitions, abbreviated or damaged words and administrative labels remain; the first strength quantity and footer digit are unresolved.
notes: The native 271-slot source retains both VDAGG copies at 25–34 and both FFXDF copies at 80–89. Excluding one instance of each is an explicitly conditional source model, not a transcription correction.
The primary model excludes 10 valid coordinates and adds 11 new slots. Ten are filled by the word proposal; one remains unknown. No added coordinate comes from an independent parallel witness.

The two five-slot gaps and the single short-group gap were explored with language heuristics. The subsequent exhaustive six-substitution minimum is conditioned on the stated partial text and constrained family; it does not independently prove that layout or historical wording.

The same-length wording retains U, the repeated ARAD, STAEKE and the footer 1C18?GLH. A missing R is not silently inserted into STAEKE. No numerical label is repaired to a preferred historical quantity.

Across tied layouts, 48 source mappings retain literal P0000, while 16 leave the leading symbol in ?0000 open. Their linked domain includes letters as well as digits and is preserved; the primary display chooses no specific count.
Source reception is 11.12 p.m., November 8. The literal question mark in UKS? belongs to the printed header, rather than the cipher plaintext mask notation.

search_family.hash_format: For canonical exclusions, append UTF-8 lines one,a,b,cost\n in ascending one-coordinate source boundary, first stage boundary and second stage boundary.
search_family.target_constraints: All stated plaintext labels are fixed except the leading strength symbol at 96. The footer unknown at 131 remains the existing VF cell; its pair is constrained without selecting 5/6. Strength index 96 retains ?A, leaving its row coordinate unconstrained.

prior_credit: Published period key: George Lasry, Ingo Niebel, Nils Kopal and Arno Wacker (2016), and George Lasry (2017 key list). Earlier repository OCR and explicitly recomputed unchanged-key diagnostics are retained. Source review, conditional partial reading and source-map audit: icekylinx and GPT-6 Astra Pro. No universal first-decipherment priority is asserted.
limits: This is a conditional partial recovery, with 10 excluded valid coordinates, 11 added slots and 6 substitutions. It is not a clean native decode or an independently witnessed full reconstruction.
The 173580 canonical gap comparisons optimize compatibility with one explicitly stated partial text; other wordings or error mechanisms are not excluded.
Both choices in each repeated group and all tied gap placements are retained. A selected display map is not a uniquely identified historical omission mechanism.
The first quantity can retain P0000 or a source-compatible leading symbol in {3,4,5,6,8,P,V}; neither a numeric interpretation nor a historical count is selected.
If the quantity leading symbol uses cell XA and is 5/6, the footer at VF must use the other digit. All global completions preserve that linkage.
